I've answered Pree in the #central-team thread: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. She said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support try it with the store login. I found no later update on it in that channel.
